items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: Louie Armstrong had to go to Europe... Most of (inaudible) -- time of all Louie Lil Armstrong used to write -- sketch out things for Louie Armstrong back in those days.

ctx.x: Yes, I heard there was [cross-talk] something going on. I don't think (inaudible) --
I don't know what it was. But anyway, it was something (inaudible). But Louie Armstrong had to go to Europe.
